```{r}

raster_list <- results_spaMM_districts$b_preds_mort_raster_tx0
template <- raster_list[[1]]
raster_list_resampled <- lapply(raster_list, function(r) {
resample(r, template, method = "bilinear") # use "bilinear" for continuous, "ngb" for categorical
})
r_stack <- stack(raster_list_resampled)
r_mean <- calc(r_stack, fun = mean)
```
